policy: Mirror FOSS only when license allows. Proprietary firmware/apps = official manufacturer / store links only.
scope: RV · camper · Class A · light truck connectivity-first; light marine FOSS OK.

entries.summary: RV antenna / ConnecT support — official Winegard only.

entries.summary: Cel-Fi cellular coverage solutions (Nextivity). Official support portal only.

entries.title: Dometic mobile apps
